response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, di.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM disp dp JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, di.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, client_count * 1.0 / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share_of_region, client_count * 1.0 / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM d ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, district_id LIMIT 10
